# Break { #timetoalign.timelines.Break }

```python
timelines.Break(
    coordinate,
    *,
    id=None,
    seed=None,
    _unknown_keys=dict[str, Any](),
    name=None,
    label=None,
    meta=dict[str, Any](),
    provenance=None,
    manifestation=None,
    ends=None,
)
```

A place the flow never goes on across.

When the flow plays up to a Break, a Jump at the same coordinate with a
destination that holds is taken; otherwise the flow ends there. With
``ends`` it is a Break only while that condition holds: a Fine ends the
flow after the D.C. A Break lies between two brackets of alternative
endings.

## Attributes {.doc-section .doc-section-attributes}

| Name          | Type                                                                                    | Description                                                                                |
|---------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| coordinate    | [Coordinate](`timetoalign.core.Coordinate`)                                             | Where the flow ends.                                                                       |
| manifestation | [FlowManifestation](`timetoalign.core.enums.FlowManifestation`) \| [str](`str`) \| None | ``fine``, ``volta`` or a word outside the vocabulary.                                      |
| ends          | [FlowCondition](`timetoalign.timelines.flowcontrol.FlowCondition`) \| None              | When the Break ends the flow; None for always. A condition that states nothing is refused. |
| name          | [str](`str`) \| None                                                                    | A display name.                                                                            |
| label         | [str](`str`) \| None                                                                    | A human-readable label.                                                                    |
| meta          | [dict](`dict`)\[[str](`str`), [Any](`typing.Any`)\]                                     | Additional metadata.                                                                       |
| provenance    | [tuple](`tuple`)\[[Provenance](`timetoalign.core.provenance.Provenance`), ...\] \| None | How the element was made and who believes it: provenance entries, or None.                 |
| id            | [str](`str`)                                                                            | The element's ID; minted with the prefix ``break`` when not given.                         |

## Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

```python
>>> from timetoalign.core import Coordinate, TimeUnit
>>> fine = Break(
...     Coordinate(32, TimeUnit.quarters),
...     manifestation="fine",
...     ends=FlowCondition(after=DestinationReference(jump="jump_1")),
... )
>>> fine.to_dict()["ends"]
{'after': {'jump': 'jump_1'}}
```
